purpose: Warn of what follows if the preceding action is not taken.
keywords: Instruction / necessary action + さもないと + consequence
Let’s leave now; otherwise we will miss the last service.
Add some water, or it will burn.
Please reply by the deadline; otherwise we cannot hold a seat.
formation: Instruction / necessary action + さもないと + consequence
mistake: The consequence follows from not complying, not from complying.
